name: How do I decide between selling my rental property with or without tenants?

mainEntity.name: How do I decide between selling my rental property with or without tenants?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to sell with or without tenants involves weighing several factors. Selling vacant can sometimes command a higher price and offer more flexibility for showings, appealing to owner-occupants. However, selling with tenants provides consistent rental income until closing. A practical tradeoff is balancing the potential for a higher sale price against the costs and time associated with vacancy, such as lost rent and staging expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Selling vacant may fetch a higher price but costs rent; selling with tenants provides income but might limit buyer appeal.
